extensionDescription.message: Makes German websites easier to read by normalizing selected gendered forms.

disableReverts.message: When disabled, changes on open pages are reverted immediately.

popupMenuDescription.message: Choose which controls are shown in the popup.

correctionCounterDescription.message: Shows the number of corrections on the current page.

activationToggleDescription.message: Shows the switch for enabling or disabling the extension.

whereCorrectPopupDescription.message: Shows options for accessible labels, quoted text, and subtitles directly in the popup.

moreSettingsButtonDescription.message: Shows the button for opening this settings page.

whatCorrectPopupDescription.message: Shows the selected rule groups directly in the popup.

individualRuleGroupsPopup.message: Individual rule groups in the popup

ruleGroupsDescription.message: Each rule group can be selected individually. Explicitly female terms are not changed across the board.

processQuotedTextDescription.message: Enabled by default. Disabling it protects directly quoted spellings within the same text segment.

processSubtitlesDescription.message: Disabled by default. Detected subtitle overlays are otherwise skipped completely; when enabled, rapid changes are batched and processed only once per frame.

previewDescription.message: Tests the current exceptions, replacements, and enabled rule groups without saving anything.

excludedDomainsDescription.message: One domain per line. Subdomains are included. Up to 100 valid domains; entries are normalized to host names.

importKeepExisting.message: Apply imported settings, keep existing replacement targets

importPreferImported.message: Apply imported settings and imported replacement targets

importReplace.message: Completely replace all settings and personal lists

browserSyncDescription.message: By default, all settings remain only on this device. Only explicitly selected categories are additionally transferred through the browser synchronization service.

syncActivationDescription.message: Synchronizes whether Sprachverstand is enabled or disabled.

syncRuleGroupsDescription.message: Synchronizes the selection of enabled and disabled rule groups.

syncExcludedDomainsDescription.message: May contain personal or internal domain names.

syncTextMediaDescription.message: Synchronizes processing of quotations, subtitles, and accessible attributes.

syncPersonalExceptionsDescription.message: May contain personal terms or complete phrases.

syncCustomReplacementsDescription.message: May contain personal source and target texts.

previewPlaceholder.message: My special form and Nutzer:innen appear here.

rule_plural_separators_description.message: Colon, asterisk, underscore, slash, period, and typographic separators, including individually reviewed special forms.

rule_plural_binnen_i_description.message: Capital I inside known person terms.

rule_plural_double_forms_description.message: Female and male plural forms are merged into one common form.

rule_singular_explicit_context_descripti.message: Clearly marked articles, determiners, and possessives, including case inflection.

rule_unmarked_singular_description.message: Gender markers and Binnen-I are normalized for known and individually reviewed person terms; ambiguous article contexts remain protected.

rule_substantivized_adjectives_descripti.message: Visibly marked forms such as Erwachsene:r and Beschäftigte:n are inflected using a lexicon.

rule_special_gender_forms_description.message: Individually reviewed special forms such as Rom*nja, Sinti*zze, and Studentys.

rule_singular_double_forms_description.message: Explicitly stated female and male singular forms of the same person term.

rule_explicit_pronouns_description.message: Only visibly gendered paired forms; ordinary female pronouns remain unchanged.

rule_natural_family_forms_description.message: Naturally feminine family terms retain their grammatical gender.

rule_title_abbreviations_description.message: Expands Prof.in and Dr.in depending on context or reduces them to the conventional title.

rule_salutation_participles_description.message: Replaces selected person terms such as Studierende, Lesende, and Arbeitnehmende; unambiguous salutations remain fully recognized.

rule_neutral_person_terms_description.message: Replaces only individually reviewed paraphrases and fixed expressions. Additional contexts are collected in the project catalog.

noticeMore.message: $COUNT$ more notices are not shown due to space limits.

noConflicts.message: No conflicts or suspicious overlaps detected.

customCheckFailed.message: Custom replacements could not be checked.

previewNoChange.message: No change in the test text.

previewFailed.message: The preview could not be created.

saved.message: Saved – open pages are reprocessed immediately.

importTooLarge.message: The import file is larger than 1 MB and will not be processed.

importPrepared.message: Settings backup checked and loaded into the form. Save to apply it.

protectedTermsLabel.message: Words or complete phrases that must never be changed

protectedTermsDescription.message: One literal exception per line; letter case is ignored. Regular expressions and placeholders are not supported. Protecting a single word does not automatically protect longer compound words. Up to 100 entries with 80 characters each. The list stays local by default and is synchronized only when explicitly selected.

customReplacementsDescription.message: One replacement per line. Letter case is respected; regular expressions and placeholders are not supported. Each replacement is applied exactly once and is not processed again by rules or other custom replacements. An empty target removes the match. Personal exceptions take priority. The list stays local by default and is synchronized only when explicitly selected.

excludedDomainsLabel.message: Disable Sprachverstand completely on these websites

backupTransferDescription.message: Exports the complete current settings state: activation, rule groups, popup display, domain exclusions, quotation, subtitle and attribute options, personal exceptions, custom replacements, and the optional browser synchronization selection.

importModeLabel.message: How to handle existing personal lists

importDescription.message: General settings from the backup are always loaded into the form. This selection only determines how existing personal exceptions and custom replacements are combined with the imported lists. Import files are read locally only after you select a file. The import is not applied until you click “Save”.

browserSyncFootnote.message: All categories are disabled by default. As soon as at least one category is enabled, the browser also stores this selection as synchronization information so other signed-in devices can load the same categories. Unselected categories are removed from synchronization storage.
